scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it's been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! What is the interest rate on my loan, and what are the total costs? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 6.990%. The total costs associated with the loan are $10,034.78. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Freddie Mac. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Got it. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and how it affected my application?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income ratio for your loan is 49%. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot explain how it affected your application.

dialogue.user:
Understood. Thank you for the information. I think I have all I need for now.

<Neutral> The agent was polite and provided the information I needed, but I was hoping for more context about how my debt-to-income ratio influenced the loan terms.
